claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fabricate's entire mechanic is transforming raw materials into a crafted product of the same material. No existing EffectAtom represents object creation from raw stock. 'alter_item_kind' is for form-switching a single existing item (Folding Boat) and carries no concept of raw-material inputs, size constraints, or proficiency gates. 'create_object' appears in the v4 taxonomy (TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §9 Effect Atoms) but is absent from types.ts.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, or clothes from flax or wool.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ObjectFilter.material — extend beyond 'metal' | 'flammable'
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The object attachment filter's material enum ('metal' | 'flammable') cannot express 'raw/unprocessed material'. Fabricate targets raw stock generally. A 'raw_material' filter concept or removal of the filter restriction would be needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose raw materials that you can see within range.

discrepancies: no content/fabricate.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
